name: Fresh Apple (medium)
descriptions: A crisp, medium-sized apple picked ripe and ready to eat.
Good shelf life when kept cool; provides fiber and natural sugars for a clean snack.
effects: Crunchy bite reduces immediate hunger and gives a light hydration boost.
Slow-release sugars provide a gentle energy lift without crash.

name: Ripe Banana
descriptions: A single ripe banana, easy to peel and eat on the go.
High in potassium and natural carbohydrates for quick replenishment.
effects: Quick-release energy for immediate activity.
Provides a satiating snack with a modest hydration contribution.

name: Single-Serve Greek Yogurt (plain, low-fat)
descriptions: A 150g cup of plain Greek yogurt, pasteurized and probiotic-rich.
Protein-dense and ready to eat; pair with fruit or eat alone.
effects: Filling protein snack that supports satiety and steady energy.
Mild hydration support from the dairy base and a soothing texture.

name: Mixed Berry Cup (ready-to-eat)
descriptions: A small container of fresh blueberries, raspberries, and strawberries.
High in vitamins and antioxidants; naturally sweet and hydrating.
effects: Light, refreshing snack that hydrates and provides natural sugars.
Great for a vitamin boost and a light energy lift.

name: Baby Carrots with Single-Serve Hummus
descriptions: A portioned pack of baby carrots paired with a single-serve hummus cup.
Crunchy vegetables plus protein-rich hummus make a balanced ready snack.
effects: Filling, fiber-forward snack that provides steady energy and satisfaction.
Hummus adds protein and healthy fats to prolong fullness.

name: Whole-Grain Turkey Wrap (ready-to-eat)
descriptions: A wheat wrap filled with sliced, cooked deli turkey, greens, and light spread.
Prepared and refrigerated; a compact, balanced meal for on-the-go.
effects: Substantial, satisfying meal replacement that restores fullness and energy.
Contains lean protein and whole grains for longer-lasting fuel.

name: Trail Mix (small bag - nuts, seeds, dried fruit)
descriptions: A 40g resealable bag of mixed nuts, seeds, and a few pieces of dried fruit.
Calorie-dense, shelf-stable, and packed with healthy fats and quick carbs.
effects: High-energy snack that quickly restores stamina and keeps you going.
Small hydration impact due to dried fruit; ideal for active breaks.

name: Hard-Boiled Egg (peeled, single)
descriptions: A single peeled hard-boiled egg, ready to eat and rich in protein.
Kept chilled; a compact source of nutrients and long-lasting fullness.
effects: Protein-dense snack that significantly increases satiety.
Provides steady energy and supports recovery after activity.

name: String Cheese (pasteurized mozzarella stick)
descriptions: A single pasteurized mozzarella stick; convenient dairy snack.
Good source of calcium and protein; ready-to-eat and individually wrapped.
effects: Quick, satisfying protein snack with moderate energy.
Easy to eat and pairs well with fruit or whole-grain crackers.

name: Fresh apple
descriptions: A crisp, medium-sized apple washed and ready to eat.
Provides a sweet, hydrating snack with natural fiber and vitamin C.
effects: Quickly satisfies a light hunger with a refreshing crunch.
Helps hydrate and provide a small boost of natural sugars and fiber.

name: Ripe banana
descriptions: A ready-to-eat ripe banana, peeled easily for on-the-go eating.
High in potassium and natural carbohydrates — a quick energy pick-me-up.
effects: Provides a sustained energy boost and helps with muscle function.
Satisfies moderate hunger with soft, easy-to-digest texture.

name: Mixed berry cup
descriptions: A small cup of washed strawberries, blueberries, and raspberries ready to eat.
Low-calorie, antioxidant-rich fruit mix ideal as a refreshing snack.
effects: Lightly satisfies hunger while delivering vitamins and a hydrating bite.
Bright, tart flavors help refresh and reset the palate.

name: Baby carrot snack pack
descriptions: A sealed handful of baby carrots, peeled and ready to eat.
Crunchy, vitamin-A rich vegetable snack that travels well.
effects: Provides a crunchy, low-calorie way to satisfy mild hunger and add fiber.
Promotes a sense of fullness without heavy calories.

name: Single-serve hummus
descriptions: A small sealed tub of hummus (chickpea-based) ready to dip.
Provides plant-based protein and healthy fats; pairs well with vegetable sticks.
effects: Adds savory flavor and modest protein to extend satiety.
Complements raw vegetables to make a balanced, ready-to-eat snack.

name: Greek yogurt cup (plain)
descriptions: Single-serve plain Greek yogurt, high in protein and ready to eat.
Thick texture suitable on its own or topped with fruit or nuts.
effects: Provides strong protein-driven satiety and a cooling, creamy mouthfeel.
Supports recovery and steadier blood sugar compared with sugary snacks.

name: Roasted mixed nuts (small pack)
descriptions: A small sealed pack of lightly roasted mixed nuts (almonds, walnuts, cashews).
Calorie-dense, rich in healthy fats and protein — good for sustained energy.
effects: Delivers a longer-lasting energy boost and strong satiety from fats and protein.
A small portion is filling and helps power through an afternoon slump.

name: Bottled spring water (500ml)
descriptions: A sealed 500ml bottle of spring water, chilled and ready to drink.
Pure hydration with no calories — essential for maintaining fluid balance.
effects: Rapidly restores hydration and can help reduce perceived hunger from mild dehydration.
Refreshing and calorie-free, useful before or after other snacks.
